.. container:: etc-mode-four-triangles

   Across the canonical algebraic number fields — :g:`Heronian (15, 13, 14) <heronian-X_9>` over :math:`\mathbb{Q}` (:math:`X_{9} = \left(\frac{973}{146},\; \frac{294}{73}\right)`), :g:`Right (3, 4, 5) <right-X_9>` over :math:`\mathbb{Q}` (:math:`X_{9} = \left(\frac{18}{11},\; \frac{12}{11}\right)`), :g:`Kepler (1, √φ, φ) <kepler-X_9>` over :math:`\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{\phi})`, :g:`Kimberling (6, 9, 13) <kimberling-X_9>` over :math:`\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{35})` (:math:`X_{9} = \left(\frac{346}{53},\; \frac{4 \sqrt{35}}{53}\right)`), :g:`Golden (φ, φ, 1) <golden-X_9>` over :math:`\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{5 + 2\sqrt{5}})`, and :g:`Gnomon (1, 1, φ) <gnomon-X_9>` over :math:`\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{5 + 2\sqrt{5}})` — **X_9** remains strictly interior (:math:`\Delta_a, \Delta_b, \Delta_c > 0`) across all six non-degenerate canonical triangles (scalene, right, and pentagon isosceles), preserving its exact homogeneous law :math:`u : v : w` without floating-point approximation. On the **Equilateral (2, 2, 2)** limit over :math:`\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{3})`, **X_9** coalesces to the symmetry center :math:`O = \left(1,\; \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}\right)`.
